note: Rustic campground on the south shore of 352-acre Carrol Lake between Woodruff and St. Germain, with a small swimming beach, a boat landing and an ADA-accessible fishing pier. A larger sandy beach is across County J at the Clear Lake picnic area. Site 112 has a long, level spur for larger rigs. --Claude
summary: NHAL rustic page and the DNR brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 19 sites (12 drive-in, 7 walk-to tent), no electricity, vault toilets, hand pumps, reservation required. Open the Thursday before Memorial Day to Labor Day. The stored website is dead. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview proposed: the drive-in sites sit under continuous canopy 50-75 m from the shore.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (the value carries no --AWH). The stored evidence ('drive-in 105/106/107/109 waterfront w/ shore access') names no source. On Esri imagery the whole campground is under continuous canopy. The campground road runs about 55 m from the nearest water (the small cove west of the spur, about 45.8891,-89.6340), and the spur to the 110-111 walk-in parking (sites 108-109, about 45.8893,-89.6320) ends 60-75 m from the shore through unbroken forest. Sites 105-107 are on the main road south of that. The brochure map shows only the walk-to tent sites 110-111 and 118-119 at the shoreline, and those are tent-only. No drive-in site is within about 50 m over open ground.
